variants.headline: Building project badly behind schedule
variants.body: A building project in the colony is badly behind schedule. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: Construction timetable falls seriously short
variants.body: Construction of a building project is severely delayed in {colony}. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: A project waits beyond its schedule
variants.body: A colony building project has fallen badly behind its schedule. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.
